description: This header file defines a template specialization for the {fmt} library to format Protocol Buffer (protobuf) message objects. It provides custom formatting options to output protobuf messages either as text, JSON, or an unknown format fallback, utilizing Google's protobuf utility functions.

classes.name: formatter<google::protobuf::Message>
classes.description: A template struct specialization in the fmt namespace that enables custom formatting of protobuf message objects based on the specified format character ('t' for text, 'j' for JSON).

methods.name: format_parse_context::iterator parse(format_parse_context & ctx)
methods.description: Parses the format specifier from the formatting context to determine if the output should be in text or JSON format.

methods.name: format_context::iterator format(const T & proto,format_context & ctx) const
methods.description: Formats the protobuf message into the specified representation (text or JSON) and writes it to the provided format context.

ctags.name: format
ctags.pattern: /^  format_context::iterator format(const T& proto, format_context& ctx) const {$/
